--- title: "How to convert from pandas to polars dataframe" subtitle: "pl.from_pandas" author: '{{< var author >}}' date: '2025-07-03' date-format: iso toc: true toc-title: 'Sections' toc-location: right toc-depth: 3 categories: [100DaysOfPolars] --- Polars is highly versatile. It can accept a Pandas dataframe and convert it into a Polars dataframe. This conversion is especially useful when working with HTML data, as Polars currently does not support reading directly from HTML. ## Reading HTML data with pandas Yes, it’s possible to read HTML tables using Pandas, just as you would read data from a CSV file. ::: {#78387ed9 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Suits_episodes' df = (pd.read_html(url)[1] [['Title', 'Directed by']] .head(4) ) df ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
Title Directed by
0 "Pilot" Kevin Bray
1 "Errors and Omissions" John Scott
2 "Inside Track" Kevin Bray
3 "Dirty Little Secrets" Dennie Gordon
``` ::: ::: ## Change from pandas to polars dataframe The `pl.from_pandas` expression allows us to turn a Pandas dataframe to a polars dataframe. Here's how to use it. ::: {#14a92837 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl pl.from_pandas(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
shape: (4, 2)
TitleDirected by
strstr
""Pilot"""Kevin Bray"
""Errors and Omissions"""John Scott"
""Inside Track"""Kevin Bray"
""Dirty Little Secrets"""Dennie Gordon"
``` ::: :::
